cases.report_quote: The host is hard-coded, so there is no user-controlled URL. `redirect: 'error'` refuses redirects, so the bearer token can't be forwarded elsewhere. DNS and TLS behavior is unverified.
cases.reason: The fixed destination and error redirect policy support the scoped control; DNS/TLS is expressly unknown.

cases.report_quote: **Host:** confirmation of the 8 KiB limit, sandbox and process identity, secret-store handling and approval behavior.
cases.reason: Host enforcement is requested as evidence, not asserted verified.

cases.report_quote: The only stderr output is `{"code":"request_failed"}` (`runner.cjs:18`), and the `catch` block drops the error object. The token is never logged.
cases.reason: Runtime request catch logs only the fixed code; startup missing-token error contains no token.

cases.report_quote: `release/runner.cjs` is the shipped runtime. `src/runner.cjs` is development source and differs only in its require path (`../release/client.cjs`). `release/client.cjs` is the only downstream caller.
cases.reason: Package bin and hidden config resolve release runtime; source require is followed to client.

cases.report_quote: Every failure yields the same `-32603` "request failed". Backend status, validation and parse errors can't be told apart by the caller.
cases.reason: Within the request error-mapping row, client validation/status/parse failures reach generic catch. Startup failure is separately identified.

cases.report_quote: `client.cjs:2` requires `Number.isInteger(limit)` and 1 to 20. A string, float or injected query text is rejected. `limit` is the only interpolated value.
cases.reason: Actual validation precedes interpolation and token-authenticated fetch.

cases.report_quote: `runner.cjs:14` rejects any method other than `tools/call`, and any tool other than `list_entries`. Trace-checked: `params` or `arguments` being null or missing throws a `TypeError` inside the `try` and is caught.
cases.reason: Read with inventory and discovery description: tools/list returns early; remaining calls enforce method/name and errors are caught.

verdict.notes: All seven keyed controls/coverage checks met. No confirmed additional security gap: protocol observations and source duplication are scoped functional/maintenance observations; limits and backend content are honestly unknown across external boundaries. Exact URL completeness is lacking for S2/S4/S5, without false provenance. No fixture execution or live verification; no deployment approval.
